title: Find the display names of users from India who own posts tagged with '<r>'
question: Find the display names of users from India who own posts tagged with '<r>' and have received at least one negative comment (score < 60). For each such user, also compute how long (in days) it took them to earn a 'Teacher' badge after creating their account.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    u.XCL_055 AS DisplayName,
    CAST(julianday(MIN(b.XCL_004)) - julianday(u.XCL_054) AS INTEGER) AS DaysToTeacherBadge
FROM users u
INNER JOIN posts p ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
INNER JOIN comments c ON c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
INNER JOIN badges b ON b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
WHERE
    u.XCL_058 = 'India'
    AND p.XCL_036 = '<r>'
    AND c.XCL_007 < 60
    AND b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
GROUP BY u.XCL_052, u.XCL_055, u.XCL_054
